name: crisis-sim-tests
description: Test tooling only. The site itself (site/) has no build step and no dependencies.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-crisis-sim --config tests/emulator/firebase.json "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-crisis-sim --config tests/emulator/firebase.json "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/rules.test.mjs tests/backend.test.mjs"
